_note: Economy baggage rules on flights between India and other countries (baggage/<slug>.html and baggage/international.html). Checked against each airline's own website. Re-check every ~3 months and bump 'checked'.

airlines.name: Emirates

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy passengers can take one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 55 x 38 x 22 cm (Premium Economy: 10 kg, same size). When you board in India, Economy and Premium Economy passengers may carry only one piece, and its length, width and height together must not be more than 115 cm. Emirates doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in. Cabin bags must fit in the overhead locker or under the seat in front of you.

personal.summary: No separate laptop bag or handbag is listed for Economy from India: it's one piece only. Reasonable duty-free shopping is allowed on top

checkin.allowance: 20 kg (USA and Canada: 1 bag of 23 kg)
25 kg (USA and Canada: 2 bags of 23 kg)
30 kg (USA and Canada: 2 bags of 23 kg)
35 kg (USA and Canada: 2 bags of 23 kg)
35 kg (USA and Canada: 2 bags of 23 kg)
40 kg / 50 kg (USA and Canada: 2 bags of 32 kg)

airlines.checkin_summary: 20 to 35 kg by fare; 1 or 2 x 23 kg to the USA
airlines.checkin_note: Flights between India and Dubai, Europe, the UK, Asia and Australia use the weight concept: you can split the total into as many bags as you like, but no single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and each bag's length, width and height together should be no more than 203 cm. Flights to and from the Americas (such as the USA and Canada) and Africa use the piece concept: you get a number of bags of up to 23 kg each in Economy, and each bag should be no more than 150 cm in total. A bag between 150 and 203 cm pays an oversize fee, and anything over 203 cm must go as cargo.
airlines.infant: An infant (under 2) gets one cabin bag of up to 5 kg (55 x 38 x 22 cm) and 10 kg of checked baggage, or 23 kg on flights to and from the Americas and Africa. You can also ask at check-in to take a fully folding stroller, a carrycot or an infant car seat to the aircraft free, if there's room. The allowance is printed on the infant's ticket. Emirates doesn't sell extra baggage on infant tickets.

excess.summary: Buy extra kilos online in 5 kg blocks, up to 50 kg, until 4 hours before departure; Emirates says this saves up to 45% on the airport rate
points: At the airport, Emirates lists USD 15 per kg between India and the Middle East or South Asia, USD 25 per kg between India and Europe or the Far East, and USD 40 per kg between India and Australia or New Zealand.

On piece-concept routes (USA, Canada), an extra bag of up to 23 kg bought at the airport costs USD 250 between South Asia and the Americas on tickets issued from 8 September 2026 (USD 225 on older tickets). Buying ahead online saves 15% on select routes, for up to 5 extra bags.
You can pay with Cash+Miles in Manage your booking. Extra allowance can only be bought on Emirates tickets (numbers starting 176) for flights Emirates operates.

sections.h: Emirates baggage from India to the USA and Canada
sections.p: These flights use the piece concept, so Economy Special includes only 1 bag of 23 kg, while Saver, Flex and Flex Plus include 2 bags of 23 kg each. A single 30 kg bag is not allowed on these routes even if your total is under the limit, so split heavy packing across two bags. Each bag should be within 150 cm (length + width + height). Emirates says a trip from Asia to the Americas that includes a sector in Europe or a stopover in Dubai of more than 24 hours uses the weight concept for the whole ticket; the baggage shown in Manage your booking tells you which applies to yours.

items: Sports equipment such as golf clubs, bicycles, ski gear, surfboards and SCUBA kit is accepted as checked baggage inside your normal allowance. Above it, normal excess baggage rates apply.
Tell Emirates at least 24 hours before the flight if you're bringing a bicycle. Any single sports item over 300 cm in total must go as cargo.

Emirates gives no special free allowance for musical instruments. An instrument can be checked in, taken in the cabin if it fits the cabin limits, or carried on a seat you pay for. Each piece must be within 300 cm in total.
Sporting firearms need Emirates' approval at least 3 days before the flight, and clearance from UAE Customs and the UAE Ministry of Defence to enter the UAE.

sections.p: Pets can't travel in the Emirates cabin (the only exception is falcons on some Dubai to Pakistan flights). A pet goes as checked baggage in the hold or as cargo. As checked baggage, Emirates lists USD 500 when the pet and cage together are up to 23 kg and 150 cm, USD 650 for 24 to 32 kg, and USD 800 above 32 kg. Contact Emirates well ahead for permits and vaccinations.

items: Online check-in opens 48 hours before the flight.
Emirates says that at most airports, check-in opens 3 hours before departure (up to 4 hours at some), so check your ticket for your airport.
In Dubai, clear passport control and security 90 minutes before departure and reach the gate 60 minutes before in Economy. Walking to the C gates can take up to 25 minutes.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged
items: Register a missing bag at the Arrivals baggage desk before you leave the airport. You get a reference number called a PIR, which you use to follow the claim on the Emirates website or app.
The Emirates app tracks your bags from check-in to loading, through a connection in Dubai, to arrival, and shows the belt number in Dubai.
To claim essential expenses for a delayed bag, contact Emirates within 21 days of getting the bag back, with receipts for the clothes and toiletries you had to buy.
Emirates asks you to fill in a Baggage Inventory Form listing what was in the bag; it can't be edited once sent. Tracing can take up to 21 days.
On a trip with more than one airline, the airline that flew the last sector handles the baggage claim.

sections.p: At Dubai Terminal 3, Emirates lists baggage wrapping at AED 40 per standard bag (AED 80 oversize), porters from AED 40, and left luggage from AED 35 per bag for up to 12 hours. Round bags, bundles, loose straps and bags with no flat side should be repacked in a cardboard box, which you can get at the wrapping kiosks before check-in.

notes: Power banks: since 1 October 2025 you can't use or charge a power bank on board. You may carry one under 100 Wh in your cabin bag, with its capacity shown, kept in the seat pocket or under the seat, never in the overhead bin. Power banks aren't allowed in checked bags.
Zamzam water: Haj and Umrah pilgrims whose trip includes Madinah or Jeddah may carry up to 5 litres in a sealed container, on top of their checked allowance.

Smart bags: a bag with a removable battery can go in the cabin if it is fully switched off, or in the hold if the battery is taken out and carried in the cabin. Smart bags with a battery that can't be removed are banned.

Medicines into the UAE: controlled medicines need approval from the UAE Ministry of Health before you travel. Carry the prescription and no more than 3 months' supply. (We last checked this on 3 November 2026.)
Skywards Gold and Platinum members get 1 extra bag on piece-concept routes, and Silver, Gold and Platinum members get extra kilos on weight-concept routes.

faq_extra.q: What is the Emirates baggage allowance from India to the USA?
faq_extra.a: Flights to and from the USA and Canada use the piece concept. In Economy, Special fares include 1 bag of 23 kg; Saver, Flex and Flex Plus include 2 bags of 23 kg each. Each bag should be within 150 cm (length + width + height). The cabin bag is 7 kg, and only one piece is allowed when you board in India.

faq_extra.q: What is the Emirates baggage allowance from India to Dubai?
faq_extra.a: Flights between India and Dubai use the weight concept. In Economy you get 20 kg on Special, 25 kg on Saver, 30 kg on Flex and 35 kg on Flex Plus, in as many bags as you like, with no bag over 32 kg. The cabin bag is 7 kg and 55 x 38 x 22 cm.

faq_extra.q: What is the Emirates baggage allowance from India to the UK and Europe?
faq_extra.a: The same as to Dubai, because these routes use the weight concept: 20 kg (Special), 25 kg (Saver), 30 kg (Flex) or 35 kg (Flex Plus) in Economy, with no single bag over 32 kg.

faq_extra.q: Can I carry a laptop bag on Emirates from India?
faq_extra.a: Not as a separate item in Economy. When you board in India, Emirates allows Economy and Premium Economy passengers only one cabin piece of up to 115 cm in total, so a laptop must fit inside your 7 kg cabin bag. Reasonable duty-free shopping is allowed on top.

faq_extra.q: What is the Emirates check-in baggage size?
faq_extra.a: On weight-concept routes (India to Dubai, Europe, Asia), each bag should be within 203 cm in total (length + width + height) and 32 kg. On routes to the USA and Canada each bag should be within 150 cm; a bag between 150 and 203 cm pays an oversize fee.

faq_extra.q: Does Emirates give extra baggage to students?
faq_extra.a: Emirates' baggage pages for India don't list a student baggage allowance, and we found no student offer page on its India website on 26 November 2026. Check the baggage shown for your fare before you pay.

faq_extra.q: How much does extra baggage cost on Emirates from India?
faq_extra.a: At the airport, Emirates lists USD 15 per kg between India and the Middle East, USD 25 per kg to Europe or the Far East, and USD 40 per kg to Australia. Buying online in 5 kg blocks up to 4 hours before departure saves up to 45%. On USA and Canada routes an extra bag costs USD 250 at the airport on tickets issued from 8 September 2026.

airlines.name: Qatar Airways

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Every Economy fare includes one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 50 x 37 x 25 cm, smaller than most Indian 55 cm trolleys. Your laptop must fit in it: a separate laptop bag counts as your cabin bag. Qatar Airways doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: Small extras are allowed on top: a small purse or briefcase, a coat, an umbrella, a small camera, some reading and duty-free bought that day. A separate laptop bag is not extra

airlines.checkin_summary: 20 kg to 35 kg, depending on your fare
airlines.checkin_note: India flights use the weight concept: any number of bags within your total. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and each bag can be up to 300 cm in total (length + width + height). Qatar Airways says exceptions apply on some routes, so check your ticket.
airlines.infant: Infants get their own 10 kg checked allowance and a free stroller or carrycot, but no cabin bag of their own.
notes: Qatar Airways won't accept round or odd-shaped items, bags tied with rope or string, items wrapped in blankets or bags with loose straps. Carefully wrapped and sealed boxes within the limits are fine.

Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh, in your cabin bag only. You can't charge a power bank on board. You may use one to charge a phone at quiet times of the flight, only while you keep it in your hand, not in a bag or overhead bin.
Zamzam water: up to 5 litres in approved bottles, only for Hajj or Umrah pilgrims flying from Jeddah, Madinah or Taif (from Qatar Airways' travel agent notice of February 2026).
Spare batteries go in your cabin bag only. Devices in checked bags must be fully switched off, not in sleep mode.

sources.label: Travel planning for infants and children
Travel Advisory: Carriage of Zamzam Water

airlines.name: Etihad Airways

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy guests on every fare, including Basic, get one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 56 x 36 x 23 cm. Etihad says laptops, purses and documents must go inside your cabin bag. It doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: No separate personal item is confirmed for Economy: laptops and purses go inside your cabin bag

checkin.allowance: No checked bag (you can pay for one)

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Basic; 25 kg to 40 kg on other fares
airlines.checkin_note: India flights use the weight concept: any number of bags within your total. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg. Extra baggage is much cheaper if you buy it online before you fly.
airlines.infant: Infants (not on Basic fares) get 10 kg of checked baggage, one 5 kg cabin piece and a free pushchair, carrycot or car seat.
notes: Power banks: only one, up to 100 Wh, with the rating marked. You can't use it on board, including to charge a phone. Keep it switched off, under the seat or in the seat pocket.
On flights to and from India, the MOBIKINS MK-PB-04 power bank is banned in all bags.
Satellite phones and GPS devices (such as Garmin) need permission from India's Department of Telecommunications to be taken to or from India.
Strong-smelling fruit such as jackfruit and durian isn't allowed on Etihad flights.

Zamzam water: one package of up to 5 litres free, sealed in a plastic container inside a cardboard box sold at the airport. From Jeddah you need an Umrah or Haj visa. Only 100 ml is allowed in the cabin.

airlines.name: flydubai

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Every fare, including Lite, includes one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 55 x 38 x 20 cm. flydubai checks the size and weight of all hand baggage at the gate, and charges for each item over the limit. It doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: One personal item as part of your hand baggage: a laptop bag, small handbag or satchel up to 25 x 33 x 20 cm that fits under the seat, plus one duty-free bag

checkin.allowance: No checked bag (you can pay for one)

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Lite; 20 kg on Value and 30 kg on Flex
airlines.checkin_note: Up to 3 bags within your total. Each bag must weigh less than 32 kg and be no more than 203 cm in total. flydubai says allowances may vary by route, so check your ticket.
airlines.infant: If your fare includes baggage, an infant gets 5 kg of hand baggage and 10 kg of checked baggage, plus a folding stroller to the gate.
notes: Bags must have at least one flat side and no loose straps. Odd-shaped items must be packed in a box, and items must not be strapped together.
Don't put money, jewellery, gold or important documents in checked bags. If your cabin bag is sent to the hold at the gate, take these out first, along with medicines and power banks.
Power banks: one only, up to 100 Wh, in hand baggage. You can't use or charge it during the flight.
Zamzam water: from Jeddah, Madinah, Taif or Yanbu, up to 5 litres free as checked baggage, sealed in approved packaging.
Medicines into the UAE: controlled medicines need approval from the UAE health ministry before you travel.

airlines.name: Air Arabia

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg, plus a 3 kg personal item
cabin.detail: Every fare includes one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 55 x 40 x 20 cm, plus one personal item up to 3 kg. Duty-free shopping must fit within the combined 10 kg, and bags over the limit at the gate may be charged.

personal.summary: One personal item, such as a handbag, laptop bag or small backpack, up to 25 x 33 x 20 cm and 3 kg

checkin.allowance: No checked bag (you can pay for one)

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Basic; 20–30 kg on Value and 30–40 kg on Ultimate
airlines.checkin_note: Each bag must weigh no more than 32 kg and measure no more than 158 cm in total. A 20 kg allowance is one bag; 30 and 40 kg can be split into up to 2 bags. Air Arabia doesn't explain which of its "20/30" amounts applies to which route, so check your booking. Extra baggage is cheaper if you book it at least 12 hours before departure.
airlines.infant: With an infant under 2 you may carry one extra 3 kg bag for baby things. No checked allowance for infants is listed.
notes: Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh, in your cabin bag only, not in the overhead bin. You can't use or charge them on board.
Zamzam water: passengers flying from Saudi Arabia may carry one 5-litre bottle free as checked baggage, bought from approved outlets at the airport.
These rules cover Air Arabia's flights to and from the UAE, including Air Arabia Abu Dhabi.

airlines.name: Saudia

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Guest Class (economy) passengers may carry one hand bag or briefcase up to 7 kg and 56 x 45 x 25 cm. It must fit in the overhead bin or under the seat, and gets a cabin baggage tag. Saudia doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: One personal item on top, such as a coat, a women's handbag, a laptop or a camera. No size limit is given

checkin.fare: Guest Saver, Basic, Semi Flex and Flex
checkin.allowance: Shown only when you book; Saudia doesn't publish it by fare
Up to 23 kg and 158 cm in total; you can pay to raise one bag to 32 kg

airlines.checkin_summary: Depends on your fare and route, shown when you book; each economy bag up to 23 kg
airlines.checkin_note: Saudia's FAQ says the free allowance depends on your fare, route and class, and is shown on your booking. Each economy bag can weigh up to 23 kg and measure up to 158 cm in total. You can pay online to raise a bag to 32 kg; anything heavier, or over 300 cm, must go as cargo.
airlines.infant: Saudia's current pages don't list a checked allowance for infants. Strollers are checked free.
notes: Zamzam water: one package of up to 5 litres, only as a separate checked item, never inside your suitcase. It's free for everyone leaving Madinah; from other Saudi airports it counts within your allowance.
Power banks: up to two, in your cabin bag only. You can't recharge them on board or use them to charge other devices.

When we checked (3 Nov 2026), Saudia's site said flights to and from Riyadh were operating through Al Qassim or Dammam, with a Saudia bus to Riyadh, and that you must collect your checked bags before the bus. Check Saudia's travel updates before you fly.
Extra baggage bought on saudia.com or the app can be up to 30% cheaper than at the airport.

airlines.name: Oman Air

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy guests get one cabin bag up to 7 kg, with length, width and height adding up to no more than 115 cm. Oman Air doesn't give separate side limits, or say whether wheels and handles count.

personal.summary: Small extras are free on top: a handbag or purse, a coat or blanket, an umbrella, a small camera, reading material, a laptop in a small bag and a mobile phone

checkin.allowance: 20 kg to or from the listed Indian cities
30 kg to or from the listed Indian cities
40 kg to or from the listed Indian cities

airlines.checkin_summary: 20 kg on Super Saver, 30 kg on Comfort and 40 kg on Flex to and from India
airlines.checkin_note: These higher allowances apply to tickets to or from Mumbai, Kozhikode, Kochi, Delhi, Goa (Mopa), Hyderabad, Lucknow, Chennai, Bengaluru and Thiruvananthapuram. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and Oman Air says heavier bags won't be accepted. Each bag can be up to 158 cm in total.
airlines.infant: An adult with an infant gets 10 kg of extra checked weight on all fares except Economy Saver. Infant carriers, cots and strollers go free.
notes: In April 2026 Oman Air raised its India allowances: Super Saver now includes 20 kg, where it used to be cabin bag only.

Power banks: cabin bag only, never checked in. Don't use or charge them during the flight, and keep them under the seat or in the seat pocket. Power banks without a visible capacity label are refused.
Pack your things in a suitcase or similar container. Oman Air may refuse bags it thinks are badly packed.

airlines.name: Gulf Air

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 6 kg
cabin.detail: Economy passengers may carry one bag or briefcase up to 6 kg and 45 x 40 x 30 cm, according to the baggage calculator on gulfair.com. That's lighter and shorter than most airlines allow, so many 55 cm trolleys won't qualify. Cabin bags are weighed and tagged at check-in.

personal.summary: Free extras on top: a handbag or purse, a laptop, a coat or blanket, an umbrella, a small camera, reading matter and infant food for the flight

airlines.checkin_summary: 30 kg on Light, 35 kg on Smart and 40 kg on Flex between India and Bahrain
airlines.checkin_note: These India allowances, from Gulf Air's baggage calculator, cover flights between Bahrain and Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Thiruvananthapuram, Goa and Kochi in both directions; other routes get 5 kg less. You can split your allowance into up to 5 bags, but no bag may weigh more than 32 kg or measure more than 158 cm in total.
airlines.infant: One checked piece up to 10 kg, a free folding stroller and car seat, and one 3 kg cabin bag.
notes: Gulf Air doesn't accept odd-shaped bags, bags wrapped in blankets or cloth, round bags without a flat side, woven sacks or plastic bags, or bags with long loose straps. Suitcases and cardboard boxes within the size limit are fine, and can be plastic-wrapped at the airport.
Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh. Don't charge them from the seat or use them to charge other devices during the flight.
Prepaid extra baggage is cheaper than at the airport and is sold in 5 kg steps.

airlines.name: Kuwait Airways

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy allows one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 56 x 46 x 25 cm. Extra items are weighed with your bags and may be charged. Kuwait Airways doesn't say whether wheels and handles count.

personal.summary: One extra item: a handbag, briefcase, coat, umbrella, small camera, walking stick, or one duty-free item bought that day

airlines.checkin_summary: 2 x 23 kg on Economy, 1 x 32 kg on Economy Saver, none on Zero Bag
airlines.checkin_note: Kuwait Airways uses pieces, not total weight: on Economy you get two bags of up to 23 kg each. No single piece may weigh more than 32 kg, and each bag can be up to 158 cm in total. Check your fare: Economy Zero Bag includes no checked bag on India routes.
airlines.infant: One piece up to 10 kg and 115 cm in total. Infants can't buy extra baggage.
notes: Zamzam water: passengers starting their trip at a Saudi airport may carry one 5-litre Zamzam piece within their free allowance, properly packed and tagged.
Pack your things in a suitcase or suitable container. Money, jewellery and valuables are at your own risk in checked bags, so carry them with you.

airlines.name: Singapore Airlines

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy allows one cabin bag up to 7 kg, with length, width and height adding up to no more than 115 cm. Bags that are too big are taken at check-in or the gate and put in the hold.

personal.summary: One extra item free: a handbag, camera bag, document bag or laptop bag up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm, a coat, an umbrella, or a small amount of duty-free

airlines.checkin_summary: 25 kg on Lite and Value, 30 kg on Standard and Flexi
airlines.checkin_note: India flights use the weight concept: you can check several bags as long as the total is within your allowance. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg; heavier bags must be repacked.
airlines.infant: Up to 10 kg checked, plus a folding stroller and a carrycot or car seat.
notes: Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh, in your cabin bag only. You can't use or charge them at any time during the flight.
Smart bags whose battery can't be removed are refused.
Durians aren't allowed in any baggage, and strong-smelling food may be refused.

airlines.name: Thai Airways

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy passengers may carry one cabin bag up to 7 kg. Thai's size table allows up to 56 x 45 x 25 cm, including wheels, handles and side pockets, but the same page also limits a cabin bag to about 115 cm (45 inches) in total. A bag at the full 56 x 45 x 25 cm adds up to 126 cm, so keep yours within 115 cm in total to be safe; our checker uses both limits. Bags may be spot-checked on a sizer or scale at check-in and at the gate.

personal.summary: Small extras on top: a handbag, purse or laptop up to 37.5 x 25 x 12.5 cm (or 75 cm in total) and 1.5 kg, a walking stick and infant food

checkin.allowance: 1 bag up to 23 kg (Thai says some destinations have no free bag on Saver)

airlines.checkin_summary: 1 bag of 23 kg on Saver and Standard, 2 bags of 23 kg on Flexi and Full Flex
airlines.checkin_note: Since 2 March 2026 (for tickets sold from 25 November 2025) Thai counts bags, not total kg, across its network, including flights to and from India. Each economy bag can weigh up to 23 kg and measure up to 158 cm in total, wheels and handles included. A heavier bag (23 to 32 kg) is charged as overweight at the airport, and no bag over 32 kg is accepted. Thai's page still shows its older weight-based table above the new rules; the piece rules are the current ones.
airlines.infant: An infant without a seat gets one checked bag up to 23 kg in economy.

excess.summary: An extra bag between India and Bangkok costs USD 95 if you buy it at least 24 hours before the flight, or USD 115 at the airport
points: Extra baggage is sold per bag. In economy each extra bag can weigh up to 23 kg and measure up to 158 cm. Buy it online, through Thai's call centre or office, or from your agent at least 24 hours before departure.

Prepaid prices for the 1st or 2nd extra bag from India: USD 95 to Bangkok, USD 115 to other Thai cities, USD 140 to Singapore, Malaysia or Vietnam, USD 170 to Japan or Korea, USD 205 to Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane and USD 235 to Europe. A 3rd extra bag costs double (USD 190 to Bangkok).
At the airport the 1st or 2nd extra bag between India and Bangkok costs USD 115.
A bag of 23 to 32 kg, or 158 to 200 cm, is charged once more at the airport rate (USD 115 between India and Bangkok). A bag of 200 to 330 cm is charged one more time on top.
Charges are in US dollars, turned into rupees on the day you pay, and they aren't refundable.

notes: Power banks: since 15 March 2025 you can't use a power bank on board. You may carry up to two, each up to 100 Wh, in your cabin bag only, never in checked baggage.
Thai may refuse checked bags that aren't properly packed. At Bangkok, Phuket and other AOT airports, bags bigger than 80 x 70 x 80 cm may have to be opened for inspection.
Liquids in your cabin bag must be in containers of 100 ml or less, all in one clear 1-litre resealable bag.

airlines.name: Vietjet
airlines.hub: Hanoi (HAN) and Ho Chi Minh City (SGN)

cabin.summary: One cabin bag and one small item, 7 kg in total
cabin.detail: On Eco and Deluxe fares you can take one main cabin bag up to 56 x 36 x 23 cm plus one small personal item, but both together must weigh no more than 7 kg. SkyBoss allows 10 kg. Every cabin bag needs a Vietjet cabin baggage tag from the check-in counter, or it can be refused at boarding, and bags may be weighed again at the gate, where fees are higher. Vietjet doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: One small item within the same 7 kg: a handbag up to 30 x 20 x 10 cm or a laptop bag up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm

checkin.allowance: No free checked bag (you can buy one)

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Eco, 20 kg on Deluxe and 30 kg on SkyBoss
airlines.checkin_note: These are Vietjet's allowances for flights of under 7 hours, which includes its direct flights between India and Vietnam (longer routes, such as to Australia, get more). No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg or measure more than 119 x 119 x 81 cm. Checked baggage is cheapest when bought with your ticket or within 24 hours of booking, and dearest at the airport.
airlines.infant: Infants under 2 get no baggage allowance on Vietjet. Strollers, wheelchairs and mobility aids travel free.

excess.summary: Buying 20 kg with your ticket costs 680,000 Vietnamese dong on India routes; at the airport it's 1,360,000 dong per 20 kg
points: Prices are per person, per flight, in Vietnamese dong (VND); the booking page shows them in rupees. Vietjet's fee table puts India in its Japan, Korea and South Asia price group.
With your ticket or within 24 hours of booking: 20 kg costs 680,000 VND, 30 kg 1,040,000 VND and 40 kg 1,370,000 VND.
Later, up to 3 hours before departure: 20 kg costs 820,000 VND, 30 kg 1,300,000 VND and 40 kg 1,650,000 VND.
At the airport, within 3 hours of departure: 1,360,000 VND per 20 kg, and 340,000 VND for each kg over what you bought.
Eco and Deluxe passengers can add 2 kg of priority cabin baggage: 530,000 VND when booking, 630,000 VND later and 800,000 VND at the airport.

notes: Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh, in your cabin bag only, never in checked baggage. Using them during the flight is strictly prohibited, and they must be kept where crew can see them.
E-cigarettes and heated tobacco devices aren't accepted at all, not even in checked baggage.
Vietjet's India travel page lists direct flights to Vietnam from New Delhi, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru and Hyderabad.
Keep cash, jewellery, cameras, laptops and phones in your cabin bag, not in checked baggage.

sources.label: Vietjet: flying from India to Vietnam

airlines.name: Malaysia Airlines

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg, small personal item included
cabin.detail: Economy passengers may take one cabin bag up to 7 kg. A bag for the overhead bin can be up to 56 x 36 x 23 cm (115 cm in total). One personal item, such as a handbag, laptop bag or briefcase, is allowed as part of the same 7 kg and goes under the seat, up to 25 x 36 x 25 cm. Malaysia Airlines doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: One handbag, laptop bag, briefcase or small camera bag (or instead a duty-free bag, an overcoat or crutches), counted within the same 7 kg. Under-seat size up to 25 x 36 x 25 cm

airlines.checkin_summary: 20 kg on Value, 25 kg on Basic and 35 kg on Flex
airlines.checkin_note: Malaysia Airlines counts the total weight of your checked bags, shown in kg on your ticket (flights between Malaysia and Japan have their own allowances). No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and each must measure less than 158 cm in total. A bag of 158 to 204 cm counts as oversized and may cost extra; anything bigger must go as cargo.
airlines.infant: An infant may bring one bag (up to 115 cm) and a fully folding stroller, pram or carrycot as cabin items, together up to 10 kg. Strollers, car seats and wheelchairs can also be checked in free. The baggage page doesn't list a separate checked allowance for infants.

excess.summary: Extra weight from India costs USD 18 per kg to Malaysia and USD 37 per kg to Singapore, Thailand or Vietnam
points: Excess baggage is charged per kg by distance zone, from where you start to your final destination. India is in Zone 3: USD 18 per kg to Malaysia, USD 37 to Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia or China, USD 48 to Australia or New Zealand and USD 54 to the UK or Europe.

You can buy extra baggage in advance in Manage My Booking or through the call centre, up to 24 hours before take-off. Malaysia Airlines recommends buying ahead but doesn't publish its prepaid prices on this page.
Extra baggage is non-refundable and works only on flights operated by Malaysia Airlines, not codeshare or MASwings flights.
If your bags still weigh more than your allowance plus what you bought, the counter charges the normal excess rate for the rest.

notes: Power banks: up to two, in your cabin bag only. Using or charging them is banned for the whole flight, and they must stay with you (under the seat or in the seat pocket, not in the overhead bin). Those over 100 Wh need airline approval; over 160 Wh are banned.
Fresh or frozen seafood can't be checked in. It may go in the cabin only, properly packed without crushed ice, and subject to your destination's quarantine rules.

airlines.name: AirAsia
airlines.hub: Kuala Lumpur (KLIA Terminal 2) and Bangkok Don Mueang (DMK)

cabin.summary: One cabin bag and one small item, 7 kg in total
cabin.detail: Every fare includes two pieces of cabin baggage: one main cabin bag up to 56 x 36 x 23 cm for the overhead bin, and one small item such as a laptop bag or handbag up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm that fits under the seat in front of you. Both together must weigh no more than 7 kg. Bags strapped, wrapped or tied together don't count as one piece. If your cabin bags weigh more than 7 kg and you haven't bought Xtra Carry-On, you must check them in and pay the checked baggage fee. AirAsia doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: One small item within the same 7 kg, such as a laptop bag or handbag, up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm

checkin.allowance: No checked bag included (buy one as an add-on)

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Low Fare; 20 kg on Value Pack Lite, Value Pack and Premium Flex; 40 kg on Premium Flatbed
airlines.checkin_note: On a Low Fare ticket you buy checked baggage as an add-on, and AirAsia says it costs less when you pre-book it than at the airport. You can buy up to 60 kg. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg or measure more than 119 x 81 x 119 cm. Online, add or upgrade baggage up to 2 hours before departure; at an airport counter, at least 4 hours before.
airlines.infant: Infants under 2 get no cabin baggage allowance on AirAsia. Children aged 2 and over get the same 7 kg as adults. A stroller or pram used by your child travels free as checked baggage; a foldable stroller can go in the cabin if it fits the cabin size and weight rules.
notes: Xtra Carry-On adds 7 kg, for 14 kg of cabin baggage in total, with no single bag over 10 kg. Since 13 April 2026 it can't be bought at the airport: book it on the AirAsia MOVE app or website up to 2 hours before departure. Without it, the airport counter sells only up to 3 kg more, for a 10 kg maximum.
Everything you buy at the airport counts in your 7 kg. Only duty-free items in a sealed tamper-evident bag (STEB), with the receipt, are exempt.

Power banks: up to two per person, each up to 100 Wh, in the cabin only, never in checked baggage. Keep them in the seat pocket or under the seat, not in the overhead bin. Using or charging a power bank is prohibited on all AirAsia flights.
Smart bags: a non-removable battery must be no more than 2.7 Wh (lithium-ion) or 0.3 g (lithium metal). A removable battery must come out and travel in the cabin.
Carry a doctor's letter with prescription medicines, and pack syringes or injectables professionally and labelled for security.

faq_extra.q: Can I buy extra cabin baggage at the airport on AirAsia?
faq_extra.a: Only up to 3 kg, for a 10 kg maximum. Since 13 April 2026 Xtra Carry-On, which takes you to 14 kg, must be pre-booked on the AirAsia MOVE app or website up to 2 hours before departure.

faq_extra.q: Is a laptop bag allowed on AirAsia besides the cabin bag?
faq_extra.a: Yes. One small item such as a laptop bag or handbag, up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm, is allowed with your main cabin bag, but both must weigh 7 kg or less together.

airlines.name: Batik Air

cabin.summary: One cabin bag and one personal item, 7 kg in total
cabin.detail: Economy passengers can take one cabin bag up to 56 x 36 x 23 cm (115 cm in total) and one personal item, such as a laptop bag or an overcoat, with a combined weight of no more than 7 kg. A bag over the size limit is taken off and loaded as checked baggage, and cabin baggage over the weight limit is charged RM 50 per kg at the boarding gate. Batik Air doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: One personal item such as a laptop bag within the same 7 kg, plus one ladies' handbag up to 22 x 27 x 8 cm or one men's pouch up to 10 x 15 x 20 cm, and one bag of airport duty-free

checkin.allowance: No free checked bag (you can buy one)

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Super Saver, 20 kg on Economy Value and 30 kg on Economy Flexi
airlines.checkin_note: These are Batik Air's free allowances on routes to and from India, by weight. No single checked bag may weigh more than 32 kg. Extra baggage can be pre-bought up to 12 hours before departure in Manage Booking, but not after you have checked in online; after that, airport excess rates apply.
airlines.infant: An infant without a seat gets no free baggage allowance on Batik Air. An infant with their own seat gets the same allowance as an adult.

excess.summary: At the airport, excess baggage from India to Malaysia costs INR 1,000 per kg; pre-bought baggage is cheaper
points: Bought with your ticket, to or from Delhi or Mumbai: MYR 90 for 10 kg, 140 for 20 kg, 230 for 30 kg and 280 for 40 kg.
Bought with your ticket, to or from Kochi or Tiruchirappalli: MYR 100, 160, 260 and 320 for 10, 20, 30 and 40 kg. Bengaluru: MYR 110, 170, 270 and 340.
Bought after booking, to or from Bengaluru, Kochi or Tiruchirappalli: MYR 165, 330, 495 and 660. Delhi or Mumbai: MYR 220, 440, 660 and 880.
Rates are per flight, in Malaysian ringgit, converted at the booking rate, plus taxes where they apply (Batik Air names India's K3 tax).
Cabin baggage over the limit is charged RM 50 per kg at the boarding gate.

notes: Power banks: up to two per person, each up to 100 Wh. Batik Air says to carry them on your person, not in your cabin bag or checked bag, and using one in the cabin is prohibited.
Smart cabin bags with a non-removable lithium battery aren't allowed in the cabin. Switch off GPS, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi functions.
Codeshare and interline flights follow the operating airline's baggage rules.

airlines.name: Cathay Pacific

cabin.summary: One cabin bag and one small item, 7 kg in total
cabin.detail: For a Delhi to Hong Kong Economy ticket, Cathay's baggage calculator allows one cabin bag up to 56 x 36 x 23 cm plus one small item up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm that fits under the seat, with a total weight limit of 7 kg for both. Both sizes include wheels, handles and side pockets. Cabin crew can't lift bags for you, so check in anything too heavy to lift into the overhead locker yourself.

personal.summary: One small item within the same 7 kg: a small handbag, laptop bag, small backpack, camera bag or briefcase up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm

airlines.checkin_summary: 1 bag of 23 kg on Light, 2 bags of 23 kg on Essential and Flex
airlines.checkin_note: Cathay counts bags (pieces), not total kg. Each bag can weigh up to 23 kg and measure up to 158 cm in total. We checked these figures in Cathay's baggage calculator for Delhi to Hong Kong; your e-ticket and Manage Booking show the allowance for your own trip.
airlines.infant: An infant without a seat gets one checked bag up to 23 kg and 115 cm, plus an approved child seat, a small bag of food and nappies for the flight, and a foldable stroller (in the cabin if it fits the cabin bag size when folded and there's space).

excess.summary: An extra bag between India and Hong Kong costs USD 130, and a bag over 23 kg costs USD 100 more
points: Extra bags are charged per piece by zone, and India is in Cathay's Zone 2. From India, an extra bag (up to 23 kg and 158 cm) costs USD 130 to Hong Kong, USD 150 to mainland China, Japan, Korea or South-East Asia, USD 200 to Australia, New Zealand, the UK or Europe, and USD 230 to the USA or Canada.
A bag of 23 to 32 kg costs an extra USD 100 to Hong Kong or Asia, or USD 150 to Australia, Europe or North America. A bag of 158 to 203 cm costs USD 200.
Buying extra baggage at least 24 hours before departure gives up to 10% off.
Fees are charged in local currency, plus tax. Bags over 32 kg or 203 cm need approval from Customer Care at least three working days before you fly.

notes: Power banks: since 30 March 2026 you may carry at most two, in your cabin bag only, and you can't use or recharge them at any time during the flight. Extra power banks are confiscated at Hong Kong airport security.
Nail scissors, letter knives and other sharp, pointed items must go in checked baggage.

airlines.name: Lufthansa

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 8 kg, plus a small personal item
cabin.detail: In Economy on long-haul flights, such as those to and from India, you can take one cabin bag up to 8 kg and 55 x 40 x 23 cm, plus one personal item up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm that fits under the seat. A garment bag, a folding pocket buggy or duty-free shopping counts within this allowance. Lufthansa checks cabin bags at the airport: one that breaks the rules is put in the hold at your cost, EUR 60 to 110 (USD 75 to 125) depending on the route, paid by credit card only. Lufthansa doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: One personal item up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm, such as a handbag or laptop bag, stowed under the seat

checkin.allowance: No free checked bag (the first bag can be added at a reduced price)
2 bags, each up to 23 kg (1 bag on Premium Economy Light)

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Economy Light, 1 bag of 23 kg on other Economy fares
airlines.checkin_note: These are Lufthansa's allowances for intercontinental flights, which include flights between India and Europe. Each Economy bag can weigh up to 23 kg and measure up to 158 cm in total; heavier or bigger bags count as excess baggage, and nothing over 32 kg is accepted. Lufthansa says the allowance printed on your ticket is the one that applies, and it can depend on your route and Miles & More status.
airlines.infant: A baby under 2 gets one checked bag up to 23 kg and 158 cm, except on Light fares, plus one free item such as a folding stroller (checked) or a car seat (in the cabin). On Economy Light, only the adult travelling with the baby can buy an extra bag.

excess.summary: On Economy Light the first bag costs EUR 70 to 85 online or EUR 105 at check-in, each way; on other fares an extra 23 kg bag costs EUR 120 to 220 online, depending on distance
points: Lufthansa charges flat rates per bag that depend on how far you fly. Its page doesn't say which distance band India flights fall into, so the ranges below cover all its intercontinental bands.
First bag on an Economy Light fare, per direction: EUR 70 to 85 on lufthansa.com, EUR 105 at check-in.
Extra 23 kg bag on other Economy fares: EUR 120 to 220 online, EUR 160 to 260 at the check-in desk.
A bag over 23 kg (up to 32 kg) or over 158 cm costs a flat EUR 100 to 150; a bag over both costs EUR 200 to 300.
Fees are charged in the currency of your departure airport, and local taxes may be added. You can book extra bags under My Bookings, at the airport or through the Service Center.

notes: Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh, in your cabin bag only. Charging or using them on board is prohibited, and they mustn't go in the overhead locker: keep them under the seat in front, in the seat pocket or on you.
Flying into India and connecting to a domestic flight? You must collect your bags, clear customs and check them in again.
On journeys to or from the USA or Canada, the baggage rules of the first airline on your ticket usually apply to the whole trip.

sources.label: Lufthansa: buying a bag at check-in

airlines.name: British Airways

cabin.summary: One cabin bag plus one handbag or backpack
cabin.detail: Every passenger, even on hand-baggage-only fares, may bring one cabin bag up to 56 x 45 x 25 cm, wheels and handles included, and one handbag or backpack up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm that fits under the seat in front. British Airways' baggage page gives no weight limit for cabin bags, but you must be able to lift yours into the overhead locker without help. The bigger bag may have to go in the hold on busy flights, so keep valuables, electronics and medicines in the handbag.

personal.summary: One handbag or backpack up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm that fits under the seat in front of you

checkin.allowance: 2 bags, each up to 23 kg (1 bag on a few routes)

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Basic, 1 bag of 23 kg on Economy and 2 bags of 23 kg on Premium Economy
airlines.checkin_note: Each checked bag can weigh up to 23 kg and measure up to 90 x 75 x 43 cm. The 23 kg can't be shared between bags, and no bag may weigh more than 32 kg. British Airways' table doesn't list separate allowances for India routes, so check yours in Manage My Booking.
airlines.infant: An infant under 2 gets one 23 kg checked bag in every cabin, except on hand-baggage-only (Basic) fares, plus an extra bag for in-flight essentials. Each infant and child can also check in up to two of these free, even on Basic fares: a folding pushchair, a car or booster seat, a travel cot or a baby back carrier.

excess.summary: A bag of 23 to 32 kg costs GBP 65 (USD 100) each way; extra bags are priced by destination and are cheapest in Manage My Booking before check-in
points: Heavy bag charge: GBP 65, EUR 75 or USD 100 per overweight bag (23 to 32 kg) per one-way journey, turned into local currency when you fly from India. Many airports, including Heathrow, take only cards.
Extra bags: you can pay for up to 10. The price depends on your destination and how many you add; British Airways shows it in Manage My Booking and doesn't publish a price list for India.
Add extra bags online before you check in to get the discounted online rate (card or Avios). After check-in, only the higher airport rate is available.
Prepaid extra bags can be refunded if you cancel them before the flight leaves.
Oversize items up to 190 x 75 x 65 cm are usually accepted within your allowance; tell British Airways at least 48 hours before you fly.

notes: Power banks: up to two per person, each up to 100 Wh with the capacity printed on it, in your hand baggage only. Seat power can't be used to charge them, and they must stay in the seat pocket or a bag under the seat. If your cabin bag goes in the hold, take power banks and spare batteries out first.
You can't pool your checked allowance with another traveller, even on the same booking.
Large screens such as TVs and computer monitors aren't accepted as checked baggage.

sources.label: British Airways restricted items and batteries

airlines.name: Turkish Airlines

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 8 kg, plus a 4 kg personal item
cabin.detail: Economy passengers may take one cabin bag up to 55 x 40 x 23 cm and 8 kg, and one personal item up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm and 4 kg that goes under the seat. Show your cabin bag at check-in to get it tagged: at the gate, untagged bags that break the rules are charged and put in the hold. On full flights you may be asked to check in a standard cabin bag, free of charge. Turkish Airlines doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: One personal item up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm and 4 kg, such as a handbag or laptop bag

checkin.allowance: Not published for India routes; Turkish Airlines says it varies by route and shows it in its baggage calculator and on your ticket
Up to 23 kg on piece-system routes, never over 32 kg, and up to 158 cm in total

airlines.checkin_summary: Depends on your route and fare; Turkish Airlines shows it in its baggage calculator and on your ticket, not on its pages
airlines.checkin_note: Turkish Airlines uses a piece system on some routes and a weight (kg) system on others, and its pages don't say which applies to India or how much each fare includes. Some EcoFly fares include no checked bag at all. On piece-system routes each economy bag can weigh up to 23 kg; on every route a single bag can't weigh more than 32 kg, and bags of 158 to 292 cm cost an oversize fee.
airlines.infant: An infant may have one 8 kg cabin bag and a stroller up to 115 cm. The infant's checked allowance is one 23 kg bag on piece-system routes or 10 kg on weight-system routes, but nothing on EcoFly routes that have no free checked bag.

excess.summary: Turkish Airlines doesn't publish extra baggage prices for India routes; its calculator shows them. An oversized bag costs USD 110 on flights to or from Türkiye
points: Extra baggage prices depend on your route and fare package (EcoFly, ExtraFly, PrimeFly and others). Turkish Airlines shows them in its baggage calculator, not on its pages, and says they can change up to 8 hours before the flight.

Oversize bags (158 to 292 cm, wheels not counted) cost USD 110 each on flights to or from Türkiye, such as India to Istanbul, and USD 150 on journeys that only connect in Istanbul, such as India to the USA. Bags over 292 cm aren't accepted.
You can pay oversize fees at a Turkish Airlines sales office, at airport check-in or through the call centre.
Star Alliance Gold members get one extra bag on piece-system routes or 20 kg more on weight-system routes.

notes: Liquids in checked baggage: no more than 5 litres in total, in sealed containers of up to 1 litre each, packed so they can't leak. Leaky cardboard or tin boxes, sacks and plastic bags aren't accepted.
Some airports don't let transit passengers carry liquids over 100 ml through transfer security, even sealed duty-free. Check your connecting airport's rules.
Travellers on different bookings (PNRs) can't combine their checked allowances.
airlines.seo_title: Turkish Airlines baggage allowance from India 2026: 8 kg cabin bag size and checked bag rules

airlines.name: IndiGo (international)

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: One cabin bag up to 7 kg, no bigger than 55 x 35 x 25 cm and 115 cm in total. IndiGo says this includes the wheels and handles. If the overhead bins are full, your bag may be checked in.

personal.summary: One personal item up to 3 kg, such as a ladies' purse or a small laptop bag

checkin.fare: Saver, Flexi Plus and other regular fares
checkin.allowance: 30 kg to and from the Gulf; 30 kg to Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta and Vietnam; 20 kg to Bangkok, Phuket, Krabi, Bali and Kathmandu
35 kg on most Gulf routes and to Singapore and Kuala Lumpur; 25 kg to Bangkok, Phuket, Krabi, Bali and Kathmandu
No free checked bag (you can buy one)

airlines.checkin_summary: 30 kg to the Gulf and Singapore, 20 kg to Bangkok, Bali and Kathmandu, in up to 2 bags
airlines.checkin_note: The allowance is per person, in up to 2 bags; a third bag costs extra. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, even if you pay for excess, and each bag must be within 158 cm in total. Prepaid extra baggage, bought online up to 2 hours before an international flight, is much cheaper than at the airport.
airlines.infant: No checked allowance for infants on international flights. One 7 kg hand bag and one stroller per infant are free.
notes: Zamzam water: on flights from Jeddah and Madinah to India, it must fit within your 30 kg allowance.
India–Kuwait: your 30 kg can include a well-packed cardboard box within 158 cm.
Power banks and spare batteries go in your cabin bag only. You can't use or charge them during the flight.
You can carry up to 5 litres of alcohol (24–70%, in shop packaging) in checked baggage.
India–Kathmandu (checked on IndiGo's baggage FAQ on 21 Nov 2026): 20 kg checked on regular fares, 25 kg on IndiGo UpFront, plus one 7 kg cabin bag and a 3 kg personal item.

sources.label: IndiGo FAQ: baggage allowance by fare and route

airlines.name: Air India (international)

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy allows one cabin bag up to 7 kg, no bigger than 55 x 40 x 20 cm and 115 cm in total. On international flights you can pay to carry a cabin bag up to 12 kg; anything heavier must be checked in.

personal.summary: One small personal item up to 3 kg that fits under the seat, such as a handbag, camera bag or laptop bag up to 40 x 30 x 20 cm

checkin.allowance: 25 kg (20 kg to and from Nepal)
30 kg (20 kg to and from Nepal)
35 kg (30 kg to and from Nepal)

airlines.checkin_summary: 25 kg on Value, 30 kg on Classic and 35 kg on Flex to the Gulf and South-East Asia; 20 kg (30 kg on Flex) to Nepal
airlines.checkin_note: These allowances cover flights between India and the Gulf (including Saudi Arabia) and South-East Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam, the Philippines and Hong Kong), in both directions. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and each bag must be within 158 cm in total. They apply only to flights run by Air India itself, not Air India Express.
airlines.infant: Up to 10 kg checked in Economy, plus a folding stroller, carrycot or car seat.
notes: Air India lists Gulf airport rules: Bahrain may reject round bags and bundles tied with rope; Muscat charges extra for bags without a flat side, tied with rope or wrapped in a blanket; Sharjah needs at least one flat side and no ropes; Dubai asks you to pack rope-tied items and plastic bags in boxes.
Zamzam water can't go inside your checked bag from Saudi airports. Only Hajj and Umrah visa holders may carry one official 5-litre bottle.
Power banks: cabin bag only, never checked, and not in the overhead bin.

India–Kathmandu (checked on Air India's SAARC baggage page on 21 Nov 2026): Economy includes 20 kg checked on Value and Classic and 30 kg on Flex, in both directions, plus one 7 kg cabin bag and a 3 kg personal item.

Air India to and from Saudi Arabia
Air India to and from Australia, Far East and Southeast Asia

airlines.name: Air India Express (international)
airlines.hub: Kochi, Kozhikode, Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru

cabin.summary: Two cabin items, 7 kg in total
cabin.detail: On international flights you may carry two cabin items that together weigh no more than 7 kg: one bag up to 56 x 36 x 23 cm, including handles, wheels and side pockets, for the overhead locker, and one laptop bag, handbag or small backpack up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm for under the seat. Items strapped or tied together don't count as one piece. To carry more, pre-book checked baggage up to four hours before departure.

personal.summary: One laptop bag, handbag or small backpack up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm, within the same 7 kg

checkin.allowance: No free checked bag (you can pre-book one)
30 kg; 20 kg on flights between India and Thailand or Nepal
30 kg on the India website; 35 kg on the UAE website (25 kg on select routes)

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Lite, 30 kg on Value (20 kg to Thailand and Nepal), 30 to 35 kg on Flex and 40 kg on Biz
airlines.checkin_note: Air India Express's baggage FAQ says international flights include 30 kg, except flights between India and Thailand or Nepal, which include 20 kg (Lite fares include none). Its India international page lists 30 kg in up to 2 pieces on Value and Flex, while its UAE booking page lists 35 kg on Flex (25 kg on select routes) and also sells a Classic fare with the same allowance as Value. Check the allowance shown for your fare before you pay.

excess.summary: Pre-book extra kg online in 5, 10, 15 or 25 kg packs; Air India Express says that's much cheaper than paying at the airport
points: You can add 5, 10, 15 or 25 kg during web check-in under Manage on the website. Baggage can be bought or upgraded on the website, the app or the Tia chatbot up to four hours before departure.
Air India Express says pre-booked extra baggage is significantly cheaper than paying excess at the airport counter.
The fees document linked from its website is dated October 2023, so we haven't quoted prices from it. Check the current price when you book.

notes: Smart bags: allowed only if a battery that can't be removed is very small (up to 0.3 g lithium metal or 2.7 Wh lithium-ion). Otherwise take the battery out and carry it in the cabin. Up to two spare batteries are allowed in cabin baggage.
Alcohol in checked baggage: Air India Express says your destination's customs rules decide how much you can carry.
Air India Express flies to 16 international destinations in the Gulf, South-East Asia and Nepal, mostly from Kerala, Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru.
